features.title: Nonlinear structural steps inside procedure graphs (preload → nonlinear → modal; thermal prefix → nonlinear)
features.acceptance: A study whose nonlinear step follows or precedes other steps (`after`) passes `runmat check` and runs to completion; state transfers into and out of the nonlinear step are tested.

features.title: Periodic fluid boundary pairs (`fluid.periodic`)
features.acceptance: A study with `fluid.periodic` on matching face pairs checks and runs; a periodic channel matches the infinite-channel Poiseuille profile.

features.title: Periodic and phase-shifted periodic magnetic boundaries for motor and transformer sectors
features.acceptance: `magnetic.periodic` and `magnetic.phase_shifted_periodic` run in magnetostatic and harmonic studies; a sector model matches the full model.

features.title: Nonzero prescribed magnetic vector potential in harmonic and magnetostatic studies
features.acceptance: A nonzero `magnetic.vector_potential` boundary value runs in magnetostatic and harmonic studies and matches a closed-form field.

features.title: Rotational (cyclic) acoustic periodicity, and periodicity in acoustic transient studies
features.acceptance: Rotated periodic pairs and transient periodic pairs run; a cyclic sector matches the full annulus modes.

features.title: Geometric-predicate region selectors (planar faces by normal, faces within a box)
features.acceptance: A region selected by a bounded geometric predicate checks with cardinality evidence, resolves to canonical ids, and stays stable across re-import of the same CAD revision.
witness: runmat check <study selecting faces by normal>.fea

features.title: Including a parameterized model with its inputs bound by name
features.acceptance: `include model.<m>(<name> = <value>, …)` checks, binds typed region, material and quantity inputs, and a study using it runs.

features.title: Vectors with one trailing unit in orientation and frame members (`origin = [0, 0, 0] m`)
features.acceptance: Every member that expects a vector quantity accepts both `[0 m, 0 m, 0 m]` and `[0, 0, 0] m` through one normalization point; orientation and frame members check clean.

features.title: Keywords allowed as declared names (`input load : force`)
features.acceptance: Declared input, let and output names may be keywords; `input load : force = 1.5 kN` checks clean and resolves as `input.load`.
